display.purpose: Single dominant page declaration and major section turns

body.purpose: Korean explanation, evidence labels, and product controls

motion.name: continuous-input
motion.purpose: Range, fracture rail, and pointer-reactive motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-priority movement into the real product experience
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:16px 32px; border-radius:9999px; background:#fff; color:#09090b; font:700 16px Pretendard,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 180ms ease-out, background 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#e4e4e7; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(147,197,253,.72); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: A real-product-led portfolio card with restrained interactive depth
components.css: .ds-product-card { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius:16px; background:#18181b; color:#fff; font-family:Pretendard,sans-serif; } .ds-card-media { aspect-ratio:16/10; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#27272a,#6d5dff); } .ds-product-card h3,.ds-product-card p { margin-inline:24px; } .ds-product-card:focus-within { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(147,197,253,.42); }

components.name: Floating Navigation
components.description: Persistent Akra navigation shared by home and product worlds
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; min-height:56px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; padding:0 24px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(9,9,11,.72); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); } .ds-nav a { color:#fff; text-decoration:none; font:600 14px Pretendard,sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(147,197,253,.72); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Waxball Split Comparison
components.description: Accessible range-controlled comparison between real intact and cutaway renders
components.css: .ds-split { position:relative; overflow:hidden; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:#101017; } .ds-split img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; } .ds-split-cutaway { position:absolute; inset:0; clip-path:inset(0 0 0 52%); } .ds-split input { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; opacity:.01; cursor:ew-resize; }

components.name: Fracture Stage Rail
components.description: Three semantic shortcuts for Surface, Fracture, and Core
components.css: .ds-stage { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:12px; } .ds-stage button { min-height:44px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); background:transparent; color:#aaa8b7; font:700 12px Pretendard,sans-serif; } .ds-stage button[aria-pressed=true] { color:#f8f7ff; border-color:#d9d1ff; }

components.name: Material Selector
components.description: Data-driven Waxball material choices using real selection art and pressed semantics
components.css: .ds-material { display:grid; min-width:96px; min-height:112px; place-items:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:16px; background:transparent; color:#aaa8b7; } .ds-material img { width:72px; aspect-ratio:1; object-fit:cover; border-radius:50%; } .ds-material[aria-pressed=true] { border-color:rgba(217,209,255,.6); color:#f8f7ff; transform:translateY(-4px); }

components.name: Evidence Media
components.description: Real screenshot or controlled walkthrough media with reserved dimensions
components.css: .ds-evidence { display:block; width:100%; max-height:760px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius:32px; background:#111; object-fit:contain; }

narrative.overview: A nearly black exhibition space where authentic product media carries the story. Individual products may add a restrained light palette while preserving the shared Akra shell.
keyCharacteristics: Flat-at-rest surfaces with explicit interaction states

rules.name: The Product Light Rule
rules.body: Product-specific color may illuminate media and key controls but does not replace global navigation or body hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Declaration Rule
rules.body: Each viewport gets one dominant editorial declaration.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Depth increases only on focus, hover, scroll entry, or primary product media.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Generated references may guide composition, but public product claims use actual captures, renders, and video.

dos: Use real product media at the largest meaningful size.
Keep Korean copy concise and test a clear mobile reading order.
Use transform-only motion for continuous input and honor reduced motion.
donts: Do not invent store ratings, usage counts, or product behavior.
Do not substitute generated mockups for real product evidence.
Do not repeat eyebrow labels above every section.
Do not cover the interface in glow borders or require hover for comprehension.
